story: ThePeopleBeaters cut the Patriots defense for the Raiders defense on Saturday, the day before Las Vegas played at New England. Drake Maye scored 39.46 for UC, the most of any player in the league, UC won by 17.42, and ThePeopleBeaters picked the Patriots defense back up on Wednesday.
Split Safety Syndicate lost by 1.94 after starting DJ Moore at flex. Moore sat out with a shoulder injury per ESPN (0.00), and Treylon Burks's 4.60 on the bench would have won it by 2.66.

Micah parsons fan club started Tyson Bagent and the Green Bay defense in the same game. Xavier McKinney picked Bagent off twice, and Micah lost by 11.22. Then they cut both of their Week 5 quarterbacks: Tyler Huntley (24.04) for Trey Smack, a kicker who missed two field goals and an extra point that Sunday, and Bagent for Stefon Diggs.
